name: Alebrije wooden figure
about: Colorful carved wooden animal figures made in Oaxaca. They are sold widely in Mexico City as a folk-art souvenir.
tip: Look for hand-painted details and ask which village or artisan made the piece.

name: Mexican Talavera ceramic
about: Hand-painted pottery from Puebla, known for its blue and white designs. Mexico City shops carry it as a classic local craft.
tip: Certified authentic Talavera costs much more, so check for a certification mark before you pay.

name: Oaxaca mezcal
about: A distilled spirit made from agave in Mexico. Mezcal is a traditional drink, and Mexico City has many specialist shops for it.
tip: Check the producer, agave type, and place of origin on the label.
